cles.en.json:faq.items.0.a: Each school runs on its own isolated database. Traffic to and from the platform is encrypted (HTTPS). Backup and access details are on the Security page. No school can access another school's data.

cles.en.json:faq.items.2.q: Does KLASSCI support the LMD system?
cles.en.json:faq.items.2.a: Yes. KLASSCI supports both classic vocational programmes and the LMD system (Bachelor-Master-Doctorate) with units, modules, credits, and semesters compliant with UEMOA standards.
cles.en.json:faq.items.3.q: How long until we're up and running?
cles.en.json:faq.items.3.a: For the one-month free trial, your account is created in 2 to 3 days. On a paid plan, expect about 2 weeks for full customisation and deployment.
cles.en.json:faq.items.4.a: Yes. The interface is fully responsive and works on smartphones, tablets, and desktops. Teachers can record attendance and grades directly from their phones.
cles.en.json:faq.items.5.q: Can I try KLASSCI for free?
cles.en.json:faq.items.5.a: The free trial lets you test KLASSCI for 1 month with up to 50 students. Your account is ready in 2 to 3 days. On a paid plan, expect about 2 weeks for full customisation and deployment.
